description: The file defines a PHP class 'UserService' within the OrangeHRM system, handling user management functionalities such as saving users, retrieving users and roles, password handling, and user searches.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class providing user management functions such as creating, retrieving, updating, deleting users, and handling passwords within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: geUserDao
methods.description: Returns the UserDao instance, initializes if not already set.

methods.name: getPasswordHasher
methods.description: Returns the PasswordHash instance, initializes if not already set.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Saves a user; handles password hashing if needed. Also respects demo mode restrictions.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a system user by user ID.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs soft deletion of users by their IDs.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves a user role by name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching search filters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on filter parameters.

methods.name: isCurrentPassword
methods.description: Checks if the provided password matches the stored password for a user.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Fetches employees assigned to a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on provided credentials, updating hashes if stored in old format.

methods.name: checkPasswordHash
methods.description: Verifies if a password matches a stored hash.

methods.name: checkForOldHash
methods.description: Checks if the hash matches an old MD5 hash of the password.

methods.name: getUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Returns user IDs that should not be deleted (e.g., current user and default admin in demo mode).
